title: LLM Judges Have Dark Current: Stratified Null and Utility Tests for LLM Judge Reliability
abstract: arXiv:2606.15610v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Passing an exact-clone null gate does not entail passing a matched target-selection utility gate. We call a non-tie preference between exact duplicates dark current. On 102 prespecified fresh RewardBench 2 rows, all four configuration--criterion cells report 0/102 clone preferences. Both neutral utility arms pass, but strict utility lower bounds of .539 and .745 miss the .75 working threshold. Conversely, re-evaluation of the same rows on two additional configurations yields a neutral gpt-oss utility pass with 2/102 clone preferences, leaving low-null behavior uncertified. A separately frozen 485-row extension passes both aggregate working gates under both criteria on one local raw-text configuration, yet strict Precise Instruction Following (Precise IF) alignment is 58/154 (.377). translated_title: LLM 评委存在“暗电流”：用于 LLM 评委可靠性的分层零假设与效用检验
translated_abstract: 通过完全克隆零假设门槛并不意味着能通过匹配的目标选择效用门槛。我们将完全重复样本之间出现的非平局偏好称为“暗电流”。在102个预先指定的全新 RewardBench 2 行样本上，所有四个配置—准则单元格均报告 0/102 的克隆偏好。两个中性效用分支均通过，但 .539 和 .745 的严格效用下限未能达到 .75 的工作阈值。相反，在两个额外配置上对相同行的重新评估产生了中性的 gpt-oss 效用通过，同时出现 2/102 的克隆偏好，使得低零假设行为未能获得认证。一个单独冻结的 485 行扩展样本在一个本地原始文本配置下、在两种准则下均通过了聚合工作门槛，但严格的精确指令遵循对齐率仅为 58/154（.377）。因此，匹配的零假设与效用结果可能产生分歧，且聚合层面的通过可能与子集层面的弱对齐并存。
tldr: 该论文提出“暗电流”概念（即 LLM 评委对完全重复样本给出非平局偏好的现象），并通过分层零假设与效用双重检验证明，仅通过零假设检验不足以认证 LLM 评委的可靠性，聚合层面的通过可能掩盖子集层面的弱对齐问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of "dark current" (non-tie preferences between exact duplicates) and stratified null and utility tests, demonstrating that passing a null gate does not certify LLM judge reliability, as matched null and utility results can diverge and aggregate passage can coexist with weak subset alignment.
